text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to change... from the
good-for-nothing
person I am now... into
someone who can bring
happiness to
everyone...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-so please... help me out with that, Big
Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
S-so please... help me out with that, Big
Sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
